names.house_1736_prairie: 1736 Prairie Avenue — the Ingraham/McBirney house, its veranda front from the c. 1890 photograph

source.citation: Chicago Daily Tribune, 8 August 1875, building permits: 'Gen. Strong, two-story and basement brick, 23x32 feet, at 882 Prairie avenue.' Library of Congress, Chronicling America, sn84031492, image 8.
what_it_does_not_supply: whether the permit is for the house McBirney bought, or for another building on the lot
what_it_supplies: a brick house of two storeys and basement permitted at old 882 Prairie in August 1875, 23 feet wide
